fnol_text: My name is Lucia Fitzgerald and I live at 561 Thornbury Road, Clinton, NC 28391. You can reach me on (555) 980-2956 or lucia.fitzgerald@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 8 November 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00002. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Fitzgerald on (555) 980-2956 to acknowledge the claim. Lucia confirmed the loss date as 8 November 2025.
Site visit to 561 Thornbury Road. Neighbour Rafael McBride was present and confirmed the timeline.
Lucia sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
